name: Basedash AI analyst landing page by Basedash in Español Français & Português
description: A warm paper-toned landing page (#f5f1ea) where airy, centered editorial headlines alternate with dense, hairline-bordered product mockups — a live BI dashboard with a chat panel, prompt-built charts, an audit log, and a 750-icon integration grid. Hierarchy is carried by a monospace orange micro-label system (trust badges, panel headers) plus serif italic testimonial quotes, giving the page a 'printed analyst report' feel. Rhythm builds from proof (logos, quotes) through capability demos to a security/compliance block, an FAQ accordion, and a closing CTA over a retro neon CRT visual, ending in a black footer.
